{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion shield''' protected a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from ionic interference, such as from [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]].<ref name="YJK">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight]]''</ref> Ion shielding could also be used to block [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans.<ref name="TT">{{WEGCite|story=The Trap (adventure scenario)|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref>

Ion shielding stations were constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], to allow starships to safely land on the world.<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
